title: lolium arundinaceum subsp. uechtritzianum
intro: Lolium arundinaceum subsp. uechtritzianum, commonly known as meadow brome, is a plant species that belongs to the grass family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's potential in treating various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues and infections.
